Spine Consultation

Date of service: 05/12/2025 | Dr. Elif Ellery, DO

Reason for consultation:
Low back pain with left leg symptoms, referred by Dr. Teodor Northcott, MD.

Review of systems:
Red flag screen negative: denies bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, fever, unexplained weight loss, or history of cancer.

Physical exam:
Back: tenderness over the lower lumbar paraspinal muscles; straight-leg raise positive on the left at 50 degrees.
Neuro: strength 4/5 in left ankle dorsiflexion and great toe extension, reflexes 2+ and symmetric, decreased light touch over the dorsum of the left foot.

Assessment and plan:
Assessment: left L5 lumbar radiculopathy.
Plan: MRI lumbar spine without contrast to evaluate for disc herniation; home exercise program; follow up after imaging.

criteria.title: Symptom duration
criteria.requirement: Low back pain, with or without radicular symptoms, has been present for at least 6 weeks before the request.
criteria.note: Stated 13 weeks matches onset 02/10/2025 to the 05/12/2025 visit (about 13 weeks), well over 6 weeks.

evidence.quote: Low back pain radiating to the left leg for 13 weeks.

criteria.title: Conservative therapy tried
criteria.requirement: At least 6 weeks of conservative therapy (physical therapy, supervised exercise and/or anti-inflammatory medication) were tried without adequate relief.
criteria.note: Six weeks of PT plus daily naproxen documented as failed; PT start 03/26/2025 to 05/12/2025 is about 6.7 weeks.

evidence.quote: Completed 6 weeks of physical therapy and daily naproxen without adequate relief.
Status: symptoms persist; patient returned to the referring physician.

criteria.title: Red-flag screen
criteria.requirement: A red-flag screen is documented (bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, fever, unexplained weight loss, history of cancer) and no page reports a red flag. Cases with red flags follow the urgent imaging pathway, which is outside this policy.
criteria.note: Negative red-flag screen documented on 05/12/2025; no page reports a red flag.

evidence.quote: Red flag screen negative: denies bowel or bladder dysfunction, saddle anesthesia, fever, unexplained weight loss, or history of cancer.

criteria.title: Neurological exam
criteria.requirement: A neurological exam (motor strength, reflexes and sensation) is documented.
criteria.note: Motor, reflex and sensory findings are all documented.

evidence.quote: Neuro: strength 4/5 in left ankle dorsiflexion and great toe extension, reflexes 2+ and symmetric, decreased light touch over the dorsum of the left foot.

criteria.title: Side matches the request
criteria.requirement: The side of the radicular symptoms in the clinical notes matches the side stated in the clinical indication of the request.
criteria.note: Request and notes both name the left side.
